To apply for this position, go ahead and scroll down to the bottom, and start filling in your details so they can consider you for this position. The next company is Lionbridge. Now, I have mentioned this company quite a few times on this channel and they are actively hiring right now for an internet safety evaluator where you can complete all the tasks from your smart phone. Now they do hire in many different countries but I am gonna focus on the jobs that are in the U.S.. We are going to go ahead and select the Internet Safety evaluator position. This is a Part-time independent contractor position so if you are interested definitely go ahead and submit your application with this company. The last opportunity is a free tutoring app called nicetalk. As a tutor. Also, high speed internet. An Android device. And also, a quiet environment. They have a drop down here where you can learn how to apply. You click that blue hyperlink. And then, if you scroll down to how much do I get paid. The pay is around $10 per hour for you to tutor students online. And you will need a PayPal account in order to receive your payments. So if you are interested in this opportunity, and you feel that you meet the qualifications, you can scroll back up to the top and click the Become a Tutor button.
